spans.s:
m. (-वाः)
The horse of INDRA.
E.
उच्चैस् high, and श्रवस् an ear, long-eared; it is sometimes written with a final vowel, nom. (-सः.)

m. (-रः)
A loud sound or voice.
E.
उच्चैस् and स्वर sound.

n. (-ष्टं)
Making a loud noise, clamour.
E.
उच्चैस् high, loud, and घुष्ट sound.

ind.
High, loud, great, much, &c.
E.
उत् much, चि to collect, डैसि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Very high, tall or lofty.
2 Very loud.
E.
उच्चैस् and तमप् aff.

ind.
1 Loudly, aloud.
2 On high, high.
E.
आसु added to the last.

Louder.
E.
उच्चैस् and तरप् aff.
